evals.prompt: Add a function to our billing service that applies a percentage discount to an order total.
evals.expected_output: Stated assumptions before coding, edge-case handling beyond the happy path, a minimal surgical implementation, and verification evidence rather than an unverified correctness claim.
expectations: States assumptions (e.g. discount range, rounding behavior) before writing code
Considers edge cases beyond the happy path (e.g. 0%, 100%, negative or invalid input)
Does not add speculative options or config not requested
Verifies the implementation (e.g. runs it or shows evidence) rather than merely asserting correctness
